answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial that binds each identity to a rate-limit nullifier. In RLN, messages exceeding the allowance reuse that nullifier; their proofs expose Shamir shares that reconstruct the private key, enabling immediate collateral slashing. Semaphore membership proofs and polynomial commitments verify eligibility without revealing identity. The labels velvet, comet, and cipher can domain-separate epochs, but do not change this enforcement.
